summary: Nathaniel Brassey Halhed worked in Indology and linguistics. Educated at Harrow School and Christ Church (1768), he served as an official for the East India Company (~1771-1785) and as secretary at East India House in 1809.

Nathaniel DeWitt Garson is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He earned his PhD at the University of Virginia under doctoral supervisor Jeffrey Hopkins and also studied under traditional teacher Khenpo Namdrol.

Nathaniel Wallich studied at Aberdeen (MD, -1819) and Copenhagen (hon. dr., -1821). He served as Superintendent of the Asiatic Society museum (1814), Superintendent of the Indian Botanic Garden (1817-1846), and Vice-President of the Linnean Society of London.

Nathmal Tatia worked in Indology, philosophy, and religious studies, earning a DLitt at the University of Calcutta under Satkari Mookerjee and studying under Sukhlal Sanghvi. He served as Director of the Jain Vishva Bharati Institute (attested 1982-1990).
Natālija Burišina is an Indologist who earned an MA in Classical Indology and Ethnology at Heidelberg University in 2020 and was an alumna there in 2024.
Navaneethakrishnan S is an Indologist who earned an MPhil from the University of Sri Lanka. In 2021, he served as a Senior Lecturer at the University of Jaffna.
Navina Lamminger is a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies who earned her PhD at the University of Munich under doctoral supervisor Franz-Karl Ehrhard.

Nawang Tsering Shakspo is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology who completed doctoral studies under Lal Mani Joshi. He served as a Lecturer at the Central Institute of Buddhist Studies (attested 1985).
Nazir Ahmad Dehlvi studied at the University of Delhi under Mamluk Ali Nanautawi (~1846-1853) and later taught Ghulam Yazdani in the field of Indology.
Nazir Ali Jairazbhoy studied at The Doon School and under Arnold Adriaan Bake (~1950-1963). Specializing in Indology, he held a post at the University of California, Los Angeles (~1975-1994).
Neal Donner is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Sinology who studied at the University of British Columbia under Leon Hurvitz (attested 1976).
Neelima Mundayar works in religious studies and Indology as a PhD student at the University of Edinburgh under doctoral supervisor Wilfried Swenden (attested 2026).

Nenghai Shi studied at Peking University under Kecheng Zhang, Foyuan, Guanyi, Khangsar Dorje Chang, and Khangsar Rinpoche, and taught Longlian. He founded the Shaocheng Society of Buddhist Studies (1917) and was vice-president of the Buddhist Association of China (1953-1966).

Nepal Das studied at Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda Educational and Research Institute (2011-2016) and National Sanskrit University (2016-2022). Specializing in Indology and philosophy, he became an assistant professor at Central Sanskrit University in 2020.
Newton Mohun Dutt worked in Indology and served as Curator of Libraries for Baroda State and at the Central Library of Vadodara (~1921-1933).
Ng-Fung Yuen studied Buddhist studies and religious studies, earning a PhD from the University of the West under doctoral supervisor Kottegoda S. Warnasuriya (attested 2009).
Ngakchang Gönpo Tsé Ten studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and Dudjom Rinpoche.

Ngan-che Chan studied at the University of Hong Kong (PhD), University of Leeds, and The Chinese University of Hong Kong, under Jing Yin and K. L. Dhammajoti. In 2023, Chan became an Assistant Professor at The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
Ngawang Jorden is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology who held a post at Sakya College and served as director of the International Buddhist Academy.
Ngawang Lek Shé Gyatso studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Dodrupchen Rinpoche, and Trulshik Rinpoche.
